lead_raw_text:
The structure of NdZr6Si2 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4_1/amd (No. 143), with a unit cell containing 36 atoms—Nd4Zr24Si8—distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Zr centers in a 13-neighbor environment (5 Si, 8 Zr) and a close-packed-like 12-neighbor arrangement (4 Nd, 4 Si, 4 Zr), while Nd and Si centers have 16 and 9 neighbors, respectively. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional, and validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner- and face-sharing between 13-vertex Zr polyhedra, plus edge-sharing between Zr 12- and 13-vertex polyhedra.
